title: Fully Cowled Mini Yonku: Super Factory (Demo)
native_title: フル・カウル・ミニ四駆 ～スーパー・ファクトリー～
overview:
Full Cowl Mini Yonku Super Factory is a racing management simulation game based on the Mini Yonku (Mini 4WD) line of toy cars produced by Tamiya and featuring characters from the Bakusō Kyōdai Let's & Go!! manga and anime by Tetsuhiro Koshita. In the main race mode, one or more players selects a car and a track, tunes 14 parts of their car based on a wide range of options, and then watches the race play out between a field of five computer-controlled racers. There is no direct control over the vehicles by the player. Up to five players can compete at once, and the game also includes a track editor.

This Special Limited Edition is the only release of the game, and includes a Gunbluster XTO Metallic Blue car model body plus a "Special Mini Book".
